name: islet
description: A small dynamic island for the GNOME top bar

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp src/metadata.json src/stylesheet.css dist/ && mkdir -p dist/schemas && cp schemas/*.gschema.xml dist/schemas/ && glib-compile-schemas --strict dist/schemas
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:gjs && npm run test:integration
